Both pinned packs match all 984 complete boundary hashes for the fixed sparse2053-decode1-v1 profile: four 512-token passes, a five-token pass and a one-token continuation. The twenty-four actual Boolean selection masks are returned by the executed indexer calls in the independent reference and native implementation. Every mask byte is compared, along with hidden outputs, recurrent/convolution and PLE state, QSA keys/values, indexer keys, final mixer and complete vocabulary logits. Sparse masks are observed without changing the reference call's returned value. All 192 large layer passes use segmented expert staging. This covers the selection threshold and partial block, not the full supported context range.

The native experimental probe's consumed-token bound rises to 2054; the production engine, context policy and automatic selection are unchanged. Each run uses the actual reclaimable-memory preflight, shared model lock, explicit process envelope and pressure supervision. Process peaks are diagnostic arithmetic-harness evidence, not the production pack's resident-memory floor or clean timing. Eight invalid fixture cases are refused, the five reference unit checks pass, and all 95 native checks pass with no skips. Full static and production regression checks from earlier frozen binaries are not claimed as rerun here. Mutable cache ownership, production generation, draft, vision, task quality and performance remain open.

Local home prefixes are replaced with <HOME>. Original byte counts and SHA-256 values identify unmodified local transcripts. Tensor fixture payloads, frozen executables and source archives remain in the bounded research directory; manifests bind their hashes. These functional runs do not qualify timing, task quality or an alternative production pack. No model is installed or activated.

### run-vq-sparse-v1.py

Original bytes: 1828. SHA-256: `8cc598173aec5ab8aab0b17e0c77302904dbe4ee376f1cc9bb467e11e8da01aa`.

````text
from pathlib import Path
import sys,json,shutil,subprocess
sys.path.insert(0,'Tools')
from quantization_logit_run import supervise,digest
r=Path('.build/quantization-research').resolve();s=Path('.build/arm64-apple-macosx/release');f=r/'frozen-sparse-native-v1';f.mkdir()
for n in ('slotstream','slotstream-checks','mlx.metallib','build-identity.json','build-source.tar.gz'):shutil.copy2(s/n,f/n)
assert digest(f/'slotstream')==json.loads((f/'build-identity.json').read_text())['binary_sha256']
for pack in ('3.2','4.4'):
 command=[str(Path('.venv/bin/python').absolute()),'Tools/vq_model_prefill_reference.py','--sparse','--model',str(r/f'candidate-{pack}'),'--inventory',str(r/f'inventory-{pack}/inventory.json'),'--architecture',str(r/'qwen4_exp-pr1788.py'),'--out',str(r/f'vq-sparse-reference-{pack}-v1')]
 print(json.dumps({'reference':pack,'result':supervise(command,r/f'vq-sparse-reference-{pack}-v1-supervision',1800)}),flush=True)
 command=[str(f/'slotstream'),'quantization-model-check','--sparse','--source-directory',str(r/f'candidate-{pack}'),'--source-inventory',str(r/f'inventory-{pack}/inventory.json'),'--fixture-directory',str(r/f'vq-sparse-reference-{pack}-v1'),'--output',str(r/f'vq-sparse-native-{pack}-v1')]
 print(json.dumps({'native':pack,'result':supervise(command,r/f'vq-sparse-native-{pack}-v1-supervision',1800)}),flush=True)
command=[sys.executable,'Tools/vq_prefill_manifest_gate.py','--sparse','--binary',str(f/'slotstream'),'--source',str(r/'candidate-3.2'),'--inventory',str(r/'inventory-3.2/inventory.json'),'--fixture',str(r/'vq-sparse-reference-3.2-v1'),'--out',str(r/'vq-sparse-manifest-v1')]
subprocess.run(command,check=True)
print(json.dumps({'catalogue':supervise([str(f/'slotstream-checks'),'--tier','t0','--tier','t1','--json'],r/'vq-sparse-catalogue-v1-supervision',600)}),flush=True)
````
